answer: Ember-Vine Attention Ledger: each identity maintains a live vine of context-dependent micro-forecasts; an ember score accrues only while the identity keeps resolving new branches with correct, non-redundant judgments, and decays when ignored. At a summit threshold, the identity can transact. Creating N sybils requires N parallel attention streams, costing the attacker the opportunity value of focused cognition plus forfeited forecasts/rewards; outsourcing or automation degrades accuracy and resets the ember.
